all_branches_sweep.procedure_of_record: measurement/carcasum_arb_challenge_prep/DESIGN.md §4.1, as extended by measurement/h2h_22016_prep/BAND_CLAIM.json and measurement/track_d2r3_prep/BAND_CLAIM.json. For EVERY ref in refs/heads and refs/remotes: read that ref's own governance/BAND_REGISTRY.csv AND every measurement/**/BAND_CLAIM*.json it carries; take the lowest integer clear of everything found anywhere across ALL refs, not just the checked-out branch's registry high-water mark.
all_branches_sweep.why_the_main_tree_check_is_insufficient: Bands 143000000000 and 144000000000 were each double-claimed on 2026-08-24 by concurrent prep sessions whose registry checks were scoped to the checked-out branch and therefore could not see an unmerged sibling freeze branch's own row. Both collisions were caught pre-launch at zero games and self-amended.

all_branches_sweep.why_150_not_146: 146000000000 carries no registry row on any ref and is, by the letter, free. It is SKIPPED anyway, on the identical reasoning carcasum_arb_challenge_prep, h2h_22016_prep and track_d2r3_prep all used when they skipped it: d1-rebase-freeze has spent a committed paragraph earmarking it for that track's own n=800 extension and asked that nothing run there without a fresh funding decision. Taking it for an unrelated cell would manufacture the exact collision the corrected procedure exists to prevent, the moment that extension is funded.
all_branches_sweep.why_150_not_149: 149000000000 is the band D2 attempt 3 spent. A burn-in abort is still a launch: ~40 decks of real records exist on it and it is RETIRED, not released. A band with records on it can never again be a clean draw for the same contrast.
all_branches_sweep.reverify_before_append: MANDATORY. The sweep is re-run immediately before the CSV append, in the stamping commit, and the append is aborted if 150000000000 has appeared anywhere in the interim.

release_if_never_launched: If this cell is never launched, 150000000000 is RELEASED under the BAND_REGISTRY.csv RELEASE-IF-NEVER-LAUNCHED clause -- a band is spent only once real records exist on it. ⚠️ THE CLAUSE DOES NOT APPLY TO A BURN-IN ABORT: if READ_RULE.md §3.2's gate fires, ~40 decks of real records exist and the band is SPENT and RETIRED, exactly as bands 141000000000, 144000000000 and 149000000000 were retired by the three prior voids. Attempt 3 is the worked example: it aborted at 80 of 800 games -- a fifth of one cell -- and its band is spent all the same.
